name: mimalloc reserved 1GiB huge OS pages at the fixed 32TiB base (mi_reserve_huge_os_pages_at, 4 pages)
required_postconditions: each of the 4 successive 1GiB huge-page mappings returns exactly the address it was asked for (start + page*MI_HUGE_OS_PAGE_SIZE)
the 4 pages are contiguous: the reservation is one unbroken [start, start+4GiB) region
end % MI_SEGMENT_SIZE == 0, so every huge page is also MI_SEGMENT_ALIGN aligned
the claimed region does not collide with the 2TiB-30TiB aligned-hint area used by _mi_os_get_aligned_hint

failure_sink.description: on a non-identical return address the loop calls _mi_warning_message("could not allocate contiguous huge OS page %zu at %p\n", page, addr) at os.c:684, frees the relocated page at os.c:685 and `break`s at os.c:687. The caller keeps whatever prefix was contiguous and reports it through *pages_reserved (os.c:712). There is no abort and no retry: a relocation silently degrades the reservation instead of failing it.

source_locations.symbol: mi_assert_internal(end % MI_SEGMENT_SIZE == 0) - compiled out when MI_DEBUG <= 1
if (p != addr) { ... break; } - the identity check
*addr = unix_mmap(hint_addr, size, MI_SEGMENT_SIZE, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, true, true, &is_large); - hint_addr is an mmap hint, MAP_FIXED is never used

extraction_limitations: the number of huge pages is a runtime option (mi_option_reserve_huge_os_pages); 4 pages / 4GiB is modelled as a representative configuration, the base address 0x200000000000 is the compile-time constant
when MI_SECURE>0 or MI_DEBUG==0 the base is randomised upward by up to 4TiB at os.c:635, so the exact address is only the lower bound of a 4TiB window; this document models the unrandomised base
'guest_host_identity_required' is used to express 'returned address must equal requested address'; mimalloc has no guest, the field is the only one in this schema that carries that postcondition
the contiguity postcondition (4 separate mmap calls must abut) has no field in this schema and is carried only as free text

x_campaign.rationale: The address is a plain mmap hint (prim.c:556 never sets MAP_FIXED) while the program compares the result for equality at os.c:681, and the measured host profile records hinted_mapping_may_relocate=true, so RS-VM-0007 should fire as Unsupported. I expect the range query to come back Unknown as well, since the probe only observed 4MiB of availability at 0x200000000000.
